RideRescue Autolink

When a car breaks down, drivers in Kenya usually rely on word of mouth and unverified contacts. RideRescue connects them with nearby verified mechanics and towing providers, shows the provider arriving in real time, and handles payment through mobile money.

  1. Driver requests help
  2. Verified mechanic matched nearby
  3. Mechanic on the way, tracked live
  4. Mechanic arrives and fixes the car
  5. Paid with mobile money, then rated
Estimated arrival–

Provider appMechanics and tow trucks accept and complete jobs
Company portalFleet owners manage vehicles and requests

Public websiteService information and onboarding

Founded January 2025. The platform is built and tested; I'm now validating it with service providers on the ground and working on payment integration and pricing.
